recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血液抹片中白血球明顯增多，以大量小至中型、核深染、胞質稀少嗜鹼的淋巴球為主，僅夾雜少數嗜中性球，符合T細胞前淋巴球白血病（T-PLL）的淋巴球增多表現。
features: Marked absolute lymphocytosis at low power
Monotonous small-to-intermediate lymphoid cells with dark round to slightly irregular nuclei
Few admixed neutrophils; no smudge cells prominent
Nucleoli and cytoplasmic blebs cannot be assessed at this magnification
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low power shows marked lymphocytosis composed of monotonous small-to-intermediate lymphoid cells with dark nuclei and scant basophilic cytoplasm. Only a few neutrophils are admixed, and smudge cells are not prominent. Nuclear contour, nucleoli, and cytoplasmic protrusions are not resolvable at this power. In the clinical and immunophenotypic context, findings are consistent with T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia (note: T-PLL is a mature T-cell neoplasm, not a precursor lymphoid neoplasm).

ddx.vs: CLL cells have soccer-ball chromatin with frequent smudge cells and are CD5+/CD23+/CD19+ B cells, whereas T-PLL is CD7-bright T cells with TCL1A rearrangement.
Sézary cells have cerebriform, grooved nuclei, and are typically CD7-negative and CD26-negative with erythroderma.
ATLL shows polylobated flower cells, CD25-positive, and HTLV-1 serology positive.
T-ALL blasts have fine blastic chromatin and are TdT-positive, unlike the mature TdT-negative T-PLL cells.
